assessment: Our source-to-contract judgment, not a claim by dataset authors
distinction: Observed-snapshot qualification additionally requires provenance/time completeness; it is stricter than merely accepting a declared mathematical input. Real operator comparator is required only for claims of superiority over practice.
scope: Five inspected releases; no universal claim about all public GPU data

available: node CPU/RAM capacities and GPU counts/types
job CPU/RAM/GPU requests and event timestamps
source-defined unrestricted policy for literal nan; default CSV has blank gpu_spec cells; gpuspec33 adds augmented policies
sources.data_origin: production-derived inventory and task requests; compatibility variant augmented
sources.inspection: downloaded node/default-task/gpuspec33 CSVs; full row audit
missing_or_unresolved: no task-to-node/device allocation ledger or simultaneous unreserved inventory
no device VRAM table or ex-ante per-device job VRAM minimum
no resource-rights owners/access policy or numerical admission priority
prohibited_inferences: gpuspec33 constraints are original measured job requirements
blank CSV cells themselves authenticate measured per-job restrictions, or documented literal nan has no defined semantics

available: node CPU/GPU capacities and GPU models
job requested GPU model, CPU/GPU quantities, worker count, submit time/duration and job class
sources.data_origin: published spot/high-priority inventory and job trace
sources.inspection: downloaded node/job CSVs; full row audit
missing_or_unresolved: no node host-RAM or job RAM/VRAM demands
request quantities per worker versus whole job not explicit
organization is not node ownership/permission; HP/Spot is not numerical priority
prohibited_inferences: submit_time+duration is an observed completion time
multiply request quantities by worker_num without resolving semantics
organization implies hardware ownership or access consent

available: pod/server association, fractional GPU and CPU requests, priority class
gpu_mem_request plus separate average GPU-memory use
sources.inspection: schema/download metadata only; large archives not downloaded
missing_or_unresolved: gpu_mem_request units and per-device versus total semantics unspecified
no host-RAM inventory/request fields or physical device identities
hourly observations do not establish simultaneous reservations or complete global pending queue
no resource-owner permissions or numerical priority scores
prohibited_inferences: average GPU memory equals requested minimum
cross-release hashed identifiers can be joined

available: gpu_type_spec in group metadata distinguishes requested type from assigned gpu_type
sources.data_origin: task/instance/machine tables plus lifetime-aggregated sensor data
sources.inspection: schema, published archive sizes and source scout; data archives not downloaded
missing_or_unresolved: per-device job VRAM requirements and complete contemporaneous reservation ledger
requested requirements cannot be replaced by lifetime utilization statistics
ownership/access/numerical priorities unresolved; distributed/sharing semantics exceed v1
prohibited_inferences: assigned GPU type equals only permitted type
observed lifetime memory statistics were known at submission

available: physical GPU assignment history and per-GPU memory inventory
host memory/CPU and GPU utilization series
sources.data_origin: published job attempts and physical GPU allocation history
sources.inspection: official schema/license and source scout; large trace archive not downloaded
missing_or_unresolved: ex-ante CPU/RAM/VRAM job requirements and permitted type/owner policy
missing/never-scheduled attempts prevent complete occupancy/demand reconstruction
unreserved availability and numerical priorities not established
prohibited_inferences: recorded execution allocation is an ex-ante request
low utilization means device is free
virtual-cluster/user label is resource ownership permission
